function.name: shell
function.arguments:
{"command": "printf '[dev]\nhost = dev.internal\nretries = 3\n\n[staging]\nhost = staging.internal\nretries = 3\ntimeout = 30\n\n[prod]\nhost = prod.internal\nretries = 3\ntimeout = 60\n' > /tmp/orig_app.ini
echo "=== diff (orig -> current) ==="; diff -u /tmp/orig_app.ini app.ini; echo "diff exit: $?"

echo "=== full file ==="; cat -A app.ini"}
